title: Inner-annulus quotients are bounded by the derivative of r ↦ μ(B_r(x₁))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P (Borel sets), x₁ ∈ ℝ^P, and ρ, d ∈ ℝ with μ(B_ρ(x₁)) < ∞, where B_r(x₁) = ball x₁ r is the open ball. Let F(r) := μ(B_r(x₁)) read as a real number (ENNReal.toReal, which is 0 if the measure is infinite). If F has derivative d at ρ (HasDerivAt F d ρ), then liminf_{h→0, h>0} h⁻¹·μ({x : ρ − h < |x − x₁| < ρ}) ≤ d, where the liminf is taken in [0, ∞] along 𝓝[>] 0 with the factor ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹, and the right side is ENNReal.ofReal d.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (x₁ : Euclid P) (ρ d : ℝ), μ (ball x₁ ρ) ≠ ∞ → HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (μ (ball x₁ r)).toReal) d ρ → liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | ρ - h < dist x x₁ ∧ dist x x₁ < ρ}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal d
